items.reason: The whole-loop catch lets one SendGrid cancellation failure skip subsequent cancellations and all accumulated database deletions.

The booking-page reschedule route forces immediateDelete=true instead of using the persisted cancellation path used by the other reschedule route. The comment adds failure and retry consequences of that same inconsistent argument.
The cancellation handler discards asynchronous reminder-helper promises, allowing it to return before cancellation state or cleanup is persisted.
The immediateDelete branch returns after provider cancellation without deleting or marking the reminder row, leaving stale scheduled records.
One failed SendGrid request aborts the cancellation loop and prevents database deletions, allowing the same row to block subsequent runs.
The forEach callbacks discard reminder cancellation promises after database cleanup moved into the helpers, so the handler can finish before cleanup completes.
